decisions.decision: Build this now in tantra-redesign/revops-os/os/scripts/api.mjs. It currently has no Drive or file tool. Add a read-only `drive` tool with two commands. `drive list <link>` reads the folder ID from any shared-folder URL. `drive pull <link> --to outputs/D1.22-d1-homework/proof/` saves the files there and exports Google Docs, Sheets and Slides as PDF. It goes through the existing request()/log()/redact() guards. Try in this order: (1) the Drive API key or service-account JSON in .env, if present; (2) public 'anyone with link' download with no key; (3) if the folder is private, print exact steps: share it to the service account email, or download it as a zip from the folder page and drop it in proof/. Only GET is allowed; anything else is refused. Add it to envReport, the brief/setup docs and D1.22's guide text. Test against a public Drive folder we own, or the vendor sim, so a shared link fills proof/. Run check-task-guides and the OS harness, then commit, push and set review.
decisions.why: This is pure agent work on our own OS, extending T-454's api.mjs. The 2026-10-09 orchestrator-autonomy rule applies. Read-only means no vendor account changes. A fallback with instructions keeps it working without any new credential from Adi.
